generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A remediation can be declared closed using proxy checks even though the exact gate that rejected the candidate was never executed successfully.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use syntax validity, focused tests, or inferred formatter rules as a substitute for the repository formatter/style gate.

reusable_control.procedure: Require exact-tool execution or terminal same-candidate CI evidence that the rejecting formatter/style gate was reached and passed.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Do not close a formatter/style remediation from syntax, self-tests, inferred configuration, or another gate; require the exact repository gate on the remediated candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: During re-audit, distinguish declared, reached, and passed and reject closure unless the exact formatter/style gate was reached and passed on the frozen candidate.

transfer_cases.evidence: synthetic exact formatter closure contract test
